summary: Bel Fuse Inc. filed a prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 1,500,000 shares of Class B common stock at $266.00 per share, with total proceeds to the company of $384,037,500. The offering is a primary capital raise under an existing shelf registration. No special situation is present; it is a routine follow-on offering with no acquisition, divestiture, or other corporate event. Delivery expected May 15, 2026. The filing is standard capital markets activity.
